work_item.title: ci: openshell physical-evidence workflow fails before job creation
work_item.notes: PR #50 restored GitHub workflow evaluation by moving runner-dependent path initialization into a runner step and added load-bearing context, commit-object, and reflog controls. Completion is limited to issue #45's CI evaluation defect; the protected physical job did not run and issues #3/#30 remain open.

test_evidence.result_summary: PR #50 head a74214370a1360488e8dce8de257bf3ff4b6e570 workflow run 31562516866 materialized both jobs; offline-contract read back 17 tests passed plus compile and CLI help checks, while physical-pair was skipped by its manual-main gate. This proves workflow evaluation and offline contract recovery only; no OpenShell physical execution, cleanup, reproduction, signing, verification, admission, or #3/#30 completion is claimed.
